question: The new item never appears. What is wrong?
options: push mutates state and passes the same array
say: The new item never appears. What is wrong?
explanation: push changes the existing state array, and setItems gets the same array back, so React skips the update. Use setItems([...items, newItem]).
explainSay: Push mutates the state array, and passing the same array back makes React skip the update.
